questions.question: What does Psalm 20 ask the LORD to do?
options: Lead the king out to certain victory
Answer the king in the day of trouble
Crown the king with glory and honor
Grant the king a long and peaceful reign
questions.answer: Answer the king in the day of trouble

questions.question: What does the psalm contrast with trusting in the LORD?
options: Some trust in chariots and horses
Trusting in vast armies of men
Trusting in idols of wood and stone
questions.answer: Some trust in chariots and horses

questions.question: The psalm says we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the _____ of the LORD our God.
May He give you the _____ of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
